description.value: Telegraph Cove Resort is a historic seasonal destination on the northeast coast of Vancouver Island, built around a restored 1912 sawmill village centred on an 800-foot boardwalk with heritage cabins used as guest accommodation. Founded in 1979, the resort offers houses, cabins, RV and tent camping, a full marina, and was home to British Columbia's first commercial whale-watching operation. A major fire on December 31, 2024 destroyed the restaurant, pub, and several landmark buildings; the resort is rebuilding and welcoming guests again for the 2026 season.
